theorem norm_Gr_le_closed (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ : θ < π / 4)
    (hs0 : -1 ≤ s.re) (hs1 : s.re ≤ 1) :
    ‖Gr s δ 0‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(θ * |s.im|)) *
      (Real.exp ((2 * π * |δ| * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 / (2 * Real.cos (2 * θ))) *
        ((1 + (2 * π * |δ| * Real.sin θ / Real.cos (2 * θ)) ^ 2) * √(π / (Real.cos (2 * θ) / 2)) +
          √π / (Real.cos (2 * θ) * √(Real.cos (2 * θ) / 2)))) :=

note: My quadrature (about 250 points, σ ∈ [0.25,3], τ ∈ [2,200], δ < 0): |F_δ|/bound ≤ 0.70 for the c₁ form and ≤ 0.75 for the c₂ form, consistent with the claimed near-optimality. In Cor 8.0.2's proof |Γ(s)|e^{πτ/2} is bounded by Stirling ((8.52)); Lean's bound needs no Γ factor.
